messages:
Alex V: quick sync — inc612 postmortem action list. Can owners confirm status/due dates and any cross-team blockers? I pasted what I have below, please correct if wrong. pinging @PriyaK @MattR @SashaL @LeahM
- Priya K: update data retention policy doc (owner: Priya) — current ETA 2026-01-28, depends on legal review
- Matt R: implement fallback routing for model variants (owner: Matt) — ETA 2026-02-02, blocked on infra PR
- Sasha L: QA + rollout plan (owner: Sasha) — ETA 2026-02-04, needs routing to be final
- Leah M: infra autoscaler change (owner: Leah) — ETA 2026-01-30, needs perf/config review

Priya K: I’ll own the retention doc. Legal queued review for Tue morning, so realistic ETA moves to 2026-02-02 if they need edits. I’ll post a draft Monday for comments. :+1:

Matt R: Routing work is WIP. Blocked on infra PR #342 — requesting perf review from eng-infra. If PR lands by EOD Mon I can hit 2026-02-02, otherwise we need a smaller fallback patch. @Leah M can you nudge infra?

Sasha L: QA plan is mostly ready, I’m holding off final tests until routing is in place so we can do end-to-end. Canary target 2026-02-03 if routing is green. I’ll add test checklist to the incident board.

Leah M: PR #342 is in staging but needs perf validation and a kernel config from runtime. I can chase infra reviews but need the config snippet from runtime team to finish perf runs.

Alex V: dropping the autoscaler config we used in canary to help perf runs:
```yaml
autoscaler:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 20
  scale_step: 2
  cpu_target: 65
  model_latency_slo_ms: 120
```
If eng-infra can’t review today I’ll escalate. Let’s aim to lock dates by EOD tomorrow.

IncidentBot: Reminder: inc612 RCA items show an upcoming due window — 3 days until first milestone. https://redwood.internal/incidents/612/actions

Matt R: ack. I left a comment on the PR asking for `perf-test: run 10k tokens` and linked the WIP patch: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/342. If reviewers can do quick perf runs today that unblocks me.

Priya K: legal confirmed they can slot review Tue morning — updating doc ETA to 2026-02-02. I’ll upload the draft Monday and note any follow-ups.

Alex V: thanks all. Final ask — owners please add your action items to the incident board, set a 'blocked_by' tag where needed, and update this thread if dates slip. I’ll do a quick check-in EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Sasha L: added tests to board and linked cases to the PRs. I’ll start canary smoke runs as soon as routing is merged.

Leah M: pinged eng-infra for perf review. If no reply by 10:00 PT tomorrow I’ll escalate to infra manager.

Alex V: setting checkpoint for 2026-01-31 18:00 UTC to confirm final owners and dates. If anything blocks earlier, reply here so we can re-prioritize. Thanks everyone.
